notes.TWN: 沒有服務。英文維基（2026-10 版）引彭博 2023 年 7 月的報導：2022 年 SpaceX 跟台灣談，堅持台灣子公司要 100% 持股，跟台灣電信業者要由本國資本控制的規定不合，談判破局。
notes.IND: 2025 年拿到統一執照與 GMPCS 授權，但 2026 年 6 月內政部的安全單位以伊朗戰爭中有人未經授權使用 Starlink 為由，凍結開始商業營運的最後核准。
notes.ZAF: 沒有核准；2025 年 6 月發現 2022 年起就有人用漫遊方案在南非使用，之後 Starlink 停掉這些用戶。
notes.IRN: 沒有核准；伊朗斷網時有團體捐贈終端，讓民眾繞過網路封鎖（地圖標為「開通但沒有核准」）。
notes.VNM: 2026 年 2 月科技部發給固定與行動衛星網路的執照。
notes.UGA: 2026-05-15 烏干達通訊委員會簽了營運執照。

notesEn.TWN: No service. English Wikipedia (October 2026 revision), citing Bloomberg in July 2023: talks in 2022 fell through when SpaceX insisted on 100% ownership of a Taiwanese subsidiary, which conflicts with Taiwan's rule that internet service providers be majority-controlled locally.
notesEn.IND: Starlink obtained a Unified License and GMPCS authorization in 2025, but in June 2026 security agencies under the Ministry of Home Affairs froze final approval for commercial operation, citing unauthorised use of Starlink terminals in the Iran conflict.
notesEn.ZAF: Not licensed; in June 2025 it emerged that people had been using roaming plans in South Africa since 2022, after which Starlink suspended them.
notesEn.IRN: Not licensed; groups have donated terminals so that Iranians can get around internet blackouts (marked on the map as active without approval).
notesEn.VNM: Licensed for fixed and mobile satellite networks by the Ministry of Science and Technology in February 2026.
notesEn.UGA: The Uganda Communications Commission signed an operating licence on 15 May 2026.
notesEn.LKA: Licensed in August 2024; service launched on 2 July 2025.
